collection: 23 source-documented public-domain MIDI references and the original MIT Launch Day example

rights.new_import_policy: Only explicit public-domain or CC0 editions are admitted as default music references.
rights.original_example: Launch Day remains an MIT-licensed original example, accessible by explicit ID and excluded from public-domain reference searches.

classification.basis: Curated theme suggestions based on source labels and parsed MIDI structure; not a listening review.
classification.titles: Names identify the documented Mutopia edition and selected movement or arrangement.
classification.key_signatures: Raw MIDI metadata, not a verified harmonic analysis.
